# Multi Gmail setup

Goal: the owner deploys their own copy of the open-source Multi Email connector (https://github.com/ecoay/multi-email) on a free Vercel account, links every Gmail inbox, and adds it to this bot as one connector. Their mail never touches anyone else's server. Read-only by default. Takes about 15 minutes.

Go one step at a time, wait for them to confirm each, and use plain words. Never ask them to paste passwords or secrets into chat; they type those into Vercel/Google directly.

1. Ask which inboxes they want linked and a short nickname for each. Save as a memory.
2. Deploy: send the Deploy to Vercel button link from the repo README. They sign in to Vercel (free Hobby plan is fine), choose an OWNER_PASSWORD and a TOKEN_ENC_KEY (a different long random string, saved in their password manager; offer to generate one). Type replace-me for the two Google values for now. Accept the Neon database it adds. Ask for their site URL when it finishes.
3. Google Cloud: create a project, enable the Gmail API, set the OAuth consent screen to External and leave it in Testing, add each Gmail address as a test user, add scope gmail.readonly, then create a Web application OAuth client with redirect URI https://SITE/api/google/callback. They copy the client ID and secret.
4. In Vercel project Settings > Environment Variables, replace GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, then Redeploy.
5. Open the site, sign in with OWNER_PASSWORD, click Add Gmail for each inbox with its nickname. On Google's unverified-app screen choose Advanced, then continue.
6. Add the custom connector URL https://SITE/api/mcp and authenticate it with OWNER_PASSWORD. Confirm with list_accounts and a small search_threads with account 'all'.
7. Save memories: the site URL, the inbox nicknames, and to search account 'all' unless a specific inbox is meant.

Tell them up front: their Google app stays in Testing to skip Google's paid audit, so Google asks them to re-approve each Gmail about every 7 days; the site marks 'Needs re-auth' and one click fixes it (Workspace Internal apps don't expire). Offer a weekly reminder routine. Drafting is off by default and it never sends mail.

Tools: list_accounts, search_threads (account = nickname, email, or all), get_message, get_thread, list_attachments, get_attachment, create_draft if enabled. One failing inbox doesn't break an 'all' search; it shows in account_errors.

# Multi Gmail: getting started

I connect all your Gmail inboxes to your bots at once, so they can search every inbox in one go. You host it yourself for free, so your mail stays yours.

1. Ask how many Gmail inboxes they want connected and what they'll use them for. Save as memories.
2. Run the multi-gmail-setup skill end to end.
3. Once list_accounts works, offer a weekly routine reminding them to re-approve any inbox marked 'Needs re-auth'.
4. Tell them other bots can use the same connector by adding the same https://SITE/api/mcp URL and approving with their owner password.
